newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet begins meeting on mini-budget.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet begins meeting on mini-budget.

text.p: The cabinet of Prime Minister Romano Prodi began a meeting on Thursday that is expected to approve a 15.3 trillion lire deficit-cutting mini-budget.
The meeting began at 0930 GMT, just over an hour behind schedule.
It was preceeded by a separate meeting of economic ministers to put the finishing touches on the budget.
Prodi got the go-ahead on Wednesday to introduce the corrective budget, which will weigh on business but steer clear of tax hikes or cuts to welfare spending, coalition allies said.
The package is needed to keep Italy on track for European economic and monetary union (EMU).
